newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Garden Botanika July sales.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Garden Botanika July sales.

text.p: Garden Botanika Inc Wednesday reported sales for the four-week fiscal period ended August 2, increased 39 percent to $6.92 million from $4.99 million in July 1996.

Store sales increased 43 percent on the strength of an increase from 186 to 269 in the number of stores and a 6 percent increase in comparable store sales. Mail order sales declined 28 percent from the prior July on a planned reduction in circulation.

For the 26 weeks ended August 2, 1997, sales increased 45 percent to $48.79 million from $33.56 million in the comparable prior period. Year to date, store sales have increased 54 percent on the strength of 83 store openings since July 1996 and a 6 percent increase in comparable store sales. Mail order sales have declined 26 percent year to date on a planned reduction in circulation.
